## Problem

Describe the bug or need and link the relevant issue, if any.

## Changes

- Describe the focused change and its operational impact.

## Verification

- List commands run and their results.
- State checks not run, pending CI, and any disposable-host testing still needed.

## Release Impact

- State whether behavior, configuration, privileges, packaging, or compatibility changes.
- Ordinary PRs do not create release tags or publish packages.

## Checklist

- [ ] The diff contains only this task's changes; no secrets or local experiment files.
- [ ] Regression coverage was added or its omission is explained.
- [ ] Relevant checks pass; unavailable checks are explicitly listed.
- [ ] User-facing changes are recorded under Unreleased in CHANGELOG.md when applicable.
- [ ] The PR title follows Conventional Commits and is suitable for a squash commit.
- [ ] Any prerequisite PR is identified and this PR remains draft until retargeted to main.
